title: Review a first shipment

domain.label: Order fulfillment
domain.description: Plan complete deliveries against accepted readiness, resource, permission, timing and financial constraints.

useCase.label: Review a first shipment
useCase.description: Can we meet this delivery commitment, and what should we verify before committing money?
